prompts.day: Use case: stylized-concept. Original 16:9 landscape background for a university welcome screen. Eastern Chinese xianxia cloud realm, cinematic realistic environment. The single wonder is an ancient peach tree growing on a low circular white-jade flower island, suspended above a boundless luminous cloud sea. Camera is low beside a shallow still-water basin on the same cloud garden, looking diagonally across the water with a natural 50mm perspective; no central bridge, no long colonnade, no distant grand palace. The old gray-brown trunk bends naturally into the upper center, its roots gripping the mineral-veined island edge; a sparse airy crown of small pale pink peach blossoms spreads across the upper band, with individual twig gaps and sky visible. A curving shallow marble basin rim enters from lower right and narrows toward the island, its joints and a few tiny standard-size stone balusters communicate scale and consistent perspective. Small ordinary-size stone steps are only at the far side of the island, no people. In the narrow central portrait crop the main tree trunk and blossoms remain recognizable in the top third, while the broad middle and lower region is calm pale cyan water with a soft partial reflection and very slight natural ripples. Thin near mist, sculpted blue-gray cloud valleys and bright textured cloud tops fade into a distant pale cyan horizon. Gentle fresh late-morning side-backlight enters from the right, grazing bark, sparse petals and white stone; transparent cool shadows, no blown whites. A tiny piece of dark timber eave at the far left is subordinate and optional, no architecture filling the frame. Real bark, fine stone mineral texture and correct physically consistent reflections, dignified airy tranquility. Background must remain readable behind centered welcome text; avoid dense branches or high-contrast reflection lines in the middle 40 percent. No text card or overlay painted into the image. No giant peach fruits, flower wall, petal storm, pink filter, cartoon tree, moon, sun disk, waterfall, giant bell, Western architecture, modern structures, magical neon, crowded objects, floating inscriptions, melted geometry, dense fog, writing, logo, watermark or interface.
prompts.night: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Original 16:9 landscape university welcome-screen background. A quiet contemporary university aerodynamics teaching lab at blue hour, centered on a small transparent wind-tunnel test section with a single cream aerodynamic wing model securely mounted inside. Photograph from a low three-quarter side viewpoint using a natural 45mm lens, looking across the short transparent chamber rather than down a hallway; instrument high in the upper center, broad quiet blue-gray epoxy floor in the middle and foreground. The tunnel's rounded rectangular pale-metal contraction is visible to the upper left, and the transparent clear acrylic test section sits on two believable dark steel supports near the upper center; a short unobtrusive duct exits toward the upper right. No running propeller exposed, no smoke streaks or projected data, no flying object. The setup is small and human-scale, a real instructional apparatus with carefully joined panels and subtle material texture, not a futuristic machine. A few tall narrow windows along the back show a softly illuminated campus under an indigo twilight sky. Cool diffused window light from behind the chamber and one warm task spotlight from upper left quietly outline the wing and acrylic edges, leaving soft legible shadows and restrained warm-cool contrast. Nothing is printed on the wing or apparatus. Distinct spatial organization: suspended-looking but physically supported horizontal apparatus across the upper third, side-on near view, generous open floor; no desk, computer screen, shelves, robot, workbench arrangement or central receding corridor. The central 26 percent phone crop retains the wing and transparent chamber at the top and an open matte floor beneath; high contrast edges and bright reflections stay above the actual center text area. Cinematic editorial architectural photography, calm curiosity, believable engineering and university scale. No people, readable letters, numbers, charts, signs, logos, watermark, UI, dark overlay, hologram, neon, science-fiction technology, distorted supports, clutter or black voids.
